==The Complete Collection==
 
 
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun and Moon—Ultra Adventures - The Complete Collection was released on DVD and Blu-ray on May 21, 2019 by VIZ Media and distributed through . Both releases each contain six discs with 48 episodes in total.
